23. 11. 2024. 
####  [ Novak appoints Andy Murray as his head coach ](https://novakdjokovic.com/en/news/novak-appoints-andy-murray-as-his-head-coach/ "Novak appoints Andy Murray as his head coach")
24-time Grand Slam champion, Novak Djokovic, has appointed his long-time rival and friend, Andy Murray, as a head coach. The agreement was finalised as a strategy plan for the upcoming season, with a primary focus on the preparation period and the Australian Open, where Novak will be aiming to capture 11th singles title.
